notes:
### OCR works on the Mac, the dial is three stops, and the assistant says what actually happened

- **On-screen text (EasyOCR) works on macOS.** It has been silently dead in
  every Mac build since mid August: the app bundle put OpenCV's loader files
  behind a symlink and the loader refused to start. The build now fixes the
  layout and refuses to ship unless OpenCV imports.
- **The ingest dial is Default, None, All.** Default is what you set up in
  Settings, applied per clip (words only where somebody spoke). None runs
  nothing after the copy. All is every signal. Words and Words + vision left
  the dial; a project that chose one opens on the same jobs with the toggles
  forced.
- **The AI Cut Planner sees every clip.** With Footage set to all days it read
  only the shoot-day timelines Sync by sound builds, so a project without one
  planned from nothing. Clips not on a day timeline now join from the catalog,
  as the assistant's pool already did.
- **A slow local model is no longer "unreachable".** Local calls wait up to
  fifteen minutes for the first word (a 27B model loading and reading a long
  conversation), and a failure says which it was: the server refused, the
  model was too slow, or the connection was cut.
- **Setup's last page fits.** The "What you chose" box was measured before
  its rows were drawn, so seven rows overlapped in a box built for two, or
  came back empty after Back. The download rail counts only what arrived and
  names a model that could not be fetched.
- **Loose files with an honest clock reach the day timeline**, and two
  crashes from 1.3.5 tester bundles are fixed. Loose drops show in the
  Sources feed; the filing sheet holds still, says where a file really goes,
  opens its folder list on a press, and can apply the first row to all.
- **Adopt Existing Clips** has the dial (opening on None), opens in the pane,
  reaches the Sources feed and the Media well, says when it is done, and
  keeps the edit as documents. Cancel no longer hangs the app behind an
  invisible question.
- **The brain pill tells the truth about a brain that cannot answer:** a
  cloud choice with no key reads "no key", a local engine that is not here
  says so, and the big Rich sizes say what they weigh. "Get it" on a local
  brain installs the Ollama runtime before pulling; your own Ollama install
  counts and is started when it is not running.
- **Tech stack rows say where each model's weights come from**, and a text
  brain's row says it runs through Ollama.
- **A Project location change keeps every project it anchored**, and Locate
  carries a project's clips with it.
- **Analysis follows the open project:** switching sets the other project's
  waiting jobs aside. Queue lanes count the project's history plus this
  session's run. On the Analyze sheet, Later closes it and All ticks
  Previews and Signals.
- **Timeline strip:** a blue line separates the video lanes from the audio
  lanes, zoom "-" always reaches Fit and "+" goes to sixteen pixels a
  frame, and the strip re-reads the day document the moment it is applied.
- **No tiny windows flash before launch.**
- **Setup:** pressing Cloud on a Local install regrows the page instead of
  squashing it, the Describe (fast) row is Moondream 2 and nothing else, and
  the receipt reads back the assistant choice.
added: Time of day sync, for lining up a whole day of cameras.
Tech stack, which scans this computer and tunes itself.
Ingest is a page, so several cards can land at once.
The assistant says what it knows, and every line has a switch.
